\backchapter{Chronology}

\noindent This chronology gathers the key dates of all forty-eight chapters. The number in
parentheses is the chapter that treats the event. Dates follow the book: ``c.'' marks an
approximate date, and a span of years stands at its first year.

\begin{chronology}

\chronhead{Before Christ}
\chron{332 BC}{Alexander the Great founds Alexandria}{ch.~\chref{3}}
\chron{29 BC}{First temple to the divinity of the emperor, at Pergamum}{ch.~\chref{4}}

\chronhead{First century}
\chron{c. 36}{Death of Stephen; the Hellenist believers scatter and begin missions}{ch.~\chref{2}}
\chron{c. 41}{James the son of Zebedee killed by Herod Agrippa I}{ch.~\chref{2}}
\chron{c. 44}{Saul joins Barnabas at Antioch}{ch.~\chref{2}}
\chron{c. 60--70}{The first gospels written}{ch.~\chref{6}}
\chron{62}{James, the brother of the Lord, murdered in Jerusalem}{ch.~\chref{2}}
\chron{64}{Nero's persecution of Christians in Rome}{ch.~\chref{2}}
\chronmore{Fire of Rome; Nero's persecution; probable martyrdom of Peter and Paul}{ch.~\chref{4}}
\chron{66}{Jewish revolt against Rome begins}{ch.~\chref{2}}
\chron{70}{Destruction of the temple; only the Pharisees' form of Judaism survives}{ch.~\chref{1}}
\chronmore{Titus destroys Jerusalem and the temple; end of the apostolic age}{ch.~\chref{2}}
\chron{c. 96}{Clement of Rome writes to Corinth}{ch.~\chref{6}}

\chron{c. 140}{Marcion comes to Rome}{ch.~\chref{6}}
\chronmore{The \emph{Shepherd of Hermas} speaks of a higher and a lower morality}{ch.~\chref{12}}
\chron{144}{Marcion excommunicated}{ch.~\chref{6}}
\chron{c. 150}{Birth of Tertullian at Carthage}{ch.~\chref{3}}
\chron{c. 150--200}{Probable date of the \emph{Gospel of Thomas}}{ch.~\chref{5}}
\chron{156--172}{Montanus begins to prophesy in Asia Minor}{ch.~\chref{6}}
\chron{c. 180}{Alexandria receives a single bishop}{ch.~\chref{7}}
\chronmore{Pantaenus opens his Christian school at Alexandria}{ch.~\chref{8}}
\chron{185}{Birth of Origen}{ch.~\chref{8}}
\chron{c. 185}{Pantaenus teaching at Alexandria}{ch.~\chref{3}}
\chron{c. 190}{The Muratorian Canon lists the Christian books}{ch.~\chref{6}}

\chronhead{Third century}
\chron{c. 200}{Serapion of Antioch consecrates Palut bishop of Edessa}{ch.~\chref{3}}

\chron{217--222}{Callistus, bishop of Rome, readmits penitent adulterers and claims Peter's

\chron{c. 229--230}{Origen ordained at Caesarea, condemned by Demetrius, settles in

\chron{249--251}{Decius makes Caesar worship compulsory throughout the empire}{ch.~\chref{4}}

\chron{c. 250}{Birth of Anthony, regarded as the first monk}{ch.~\chref{12}}
